title: Unit 23 Consolidation: The City and Its Surroundings
goal: I can describe commuting, former industrial areas and transport in and around Budapest, naming whose view each is.
I can talk about the City Park dispute and the 15-minute city.
I can sum up the debate on the future of the city.
